# Taskflow

MIT, v4.1.0, commit45366fe5bc4f2f8ec9aa590b40c504e296886865.
https://github.com/taskflow/taskflow

Unmodified70-file header library vendored under taskflow/, consumed by cmake/taskflow.cmake (no new configure-time download). Compile only host_background asC++20; core remainsC++17. One shared two-worker below-normal executor replaces detached Donut/XeGTAO/NIS preparation and DLSS-file hashing workers. No synchronous render-hook waits or persistent observation/capture loops on this pool. Ship LICENSE with binaries.
